# Hippius - Distributed Cloud Storage

> Hippius is a distributed cloud: encrypted file storage (Drive), S3-compatible object storage, and a registry for AI models and containers (Hub). One account pays for all of them.

This file is the long reference for the whole product.
The short index is https://docs.hippius.com/llms.txt
The commands an agent can run are in Tools an agent can run. S3 is written out in full after that.

## What is Hippius?

Hippius is a distributed cloud. Store encrypted files, serve objects over S3, and publish models and containers. Storage is Arion (Reed-Solomon erasure coding and CRUSH placement) plus a Substrate chain.

### Products

| Product | What an agent needs | Open |
|---|---|---|
| Drive | Encrypted files in the browser. Not S3. Files do not cross between them. | https://docs.hippius.com/use/drive |
| Shared drives | A Drive someone else owns and invited you into. They pay for the storage. | https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/shared-drives |
| S3 | S3-compatible API. Endpoint https://s3.hippius.com only. Region `decentralized`. Path-style. Access key ids start with `hip_`. | https://docs.hippius.com/use/quickstart |
| Hub | Models and container images. Command: `hippius-hub`. Creating a namespace needs a balance of at least $10 (`REGISTRY_MIN_CREDITS`). The plan price stays zero. | https://docs.hippius.com/registry |
| Desktop | Sync folders on macOS, Windows, and Linux. There is no CLI. The agent file is on the staging branch. | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-desktop/staging/llms.txt |
| Mobile | Drive on Android, on Google Play. The iPhone app is not released. There is no CLI. | https://docs.hippius.com/use/mobile/getting-started |
| Console | Sign up, pay, API token, Drive and S3 keys. There is no CLI. The agent calls https://api.hippius.com with the account token. | https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/getting-started |
| Drive SDK | Script Drive with encryption on the client. Command: `hippius-drive`. Install from git, not PyPI. | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-drive-sdk/main/llms.txt |
| Bridge | No CLI. The user signs each step in a browser wallet. Alpha and hAlpha are pegged 1:1. Minimum 15. | https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/bridge |
| Compute | No CLI and no public API. Not offered yet. | https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/virtual-machines |

### Authentication

Sign in at https://console.hippius.com with Google, GitHub, Apple, or an existing 12-word access key. There is no email and password sign-in. An agent cannot create the account. That happens in the browser or the app.

A 12-word access key creates a wallet-only account. It has no real email address, so it gets no lifecycle mail. Drive has no free plan: subscribe before the first upload. S3 and Hub work the same as on any other account.

S3 access keys (`hip_*`) are created in the console and used with any S3 client. The account API token is on console Settings: https://console.hippius.com/dashboard/settings

### Paying

Top up the balance, then subscribe to a plan. A top-up does not add storage. 1 USDC adds one dollar to your balance. https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/billing

Four top-up methods, on Billing:

- Card, through Stripe, from $10 to $10,000, or a monthly auto reload.
- Bitcoin, on-chain or Lightning, from $20 to $10,000. Lightning lands in seconds. On-chain waits for one confirmation.
- USDC on Base, from a browser wallet, from $5 to $10,000. 1 USDC adds one dollar to your balance.
- TAO, from a connected wallet or by sending to the deposit address. Minimum $20. A transfer cannot be reversed.

An agent with enough balance subscribes without a browser. Do not send a funded agent to Stripe Checkout.

Drive (codes `solo` Starter, `duo` Plus, `max`, `scale`; Free needs no subscribe):

    curl -X POST https://api.hippius.com/api/drive/subscription/ \
      -H "Authorization: Token YOUR_TOKEN" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"plan":"solo","period":"monthly","payment":"credits"}'
    # 201 if the balance covers the plan. `payment` JSON value `credits` means pay from the existing balance.

S3 (codes `pro`, `business`, `enterprise`; otherwise pay as you go at $6/TB-month):

    curl -X POST https://api.hippius.com/api/s3/subscription/ \
      -H "Authorization: Token YOUR_TOKEN" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"plan":"pro","rail":"credits"}'

Hub (names Free, Builder, Pro, Team; paid from the balance only):

    curl -X POST https://api.hippius.com/api/registry/subscribe/ \
      -H "Authorization: Token YOUR_TOKEN" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"plan":"Builder"}'

Catalogs (no auth): GET https://api.hippius.com/api/drive/plans/ · GET https://api.hippius.com/api/s3/plans/ · GET https://api.hippius.com/api/registry/plans/

Google, GitHub, and Apple accounts include the Free Drive Plan (10 GB). S3 starts on pay as you go at $6 per TB per month. A plan is optional. Creating a Hub namespace needs a balance of at least $10.

Open a support ticket with the account API token: POST https://api.hippius.com/api/support/tickets/ with subject, priority, category, and description.

---

## Tools an agent can run

`hipc` and the storage commands in `pip install hippius` are deprecated. Do not use them. Chain registration still uses `hippius`. S3 uses any S3 client, and that manual starts at S3 Storage — Quickstart. The tools below are the other products.

An agent cannot create the account or approve a browser login. The user does that at https://console.hippius.com. The API token is on https://console.hippius.com/dashboard/settings

### Hub

`hippius-hub` publishes models and container images. Full cheat sheet: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-hub/main/llms.txt

```bash
pip install hippius_hub
hippius-hub login --hippius-token "$HIPPIUS_TOKEN"
hippius-hub registry check my-models
hippius-hub registry provision my-models --docker-login
hippius-hub upload my-models/qwen-7b ./qwen-7b --revision v1
```

Creating a namespace needs a balance of at least $10 on the account. A zero balance is refused. The plan price stays zero. Top up, then provision.

Two logins. `hippius-hub registry` and `hippius-hub models` use the API token saved by `login --hippius-token`. `upload`, `download`, `docker`, and `oras` use the registry robot secret that `provision` prints once. Lost that secret: `hippius-hub registry rotate-token --docker-login`. The old secret stops working immediately.

Namespace names are lowercase letters, digits, and dashes, 1 to 63 characters. Artifacts live at `registry.hippius.com/<namespace>/<repo>:<tag>`. Public images pull with no login. Hub plans are paid from the balance only.

### Drive

`hippius-drive` reads and writes the same encrypted Drive as the console, the desktop app, and the Android app. It is alpha. It is not S3: a file put here does not appear in a bucket. Full command list: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-drive-sdk/main/docs/cli.md

The package name `hippius-drive` is not on PyPI. Python 3.10 to 3.13.

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-drive-sdk"
export HIPPIUS_TOKEN=...            # console Settings
export HIPPIUS_ACCOUNT_SS58=...     # the account that token belongs to
export HIPPIUS_PASSWORD=...         # unlock password. Prompted on a terminal. Required when there is no terminal.
hippius-drive init --mnemonic "$RECOVERY_PHRASE"
hippius-drive whoami
hippius-drive register
hippius-drive put report.pdf work/report.pdf
hippius-drive ls --all
hippius-drive get work/report.pdf out.pdf
```

`init` with no `--mnemonic` generates a new 24-word phrase and prints it once. That phrase does not decrypt files already in the account. Import the account's existing recovery phrase. Do not ask the user to paste the phrase or the unlock password into chat.

A token and an address that do not belong together fail `whoami` with 403. Leave the server unset: the CLI probes and uses the first Drive region that answers. Set `HIPPIUS_SERVER_URL` only for a specific server.

`share` and `folder-share` create links. `invite` and `drives` are the shared-drive commands. There is no published console guide for shared drives. The CLI page above is the reference.

### Console

There is no console CLI. Sign-in, plan checkout in the browser, and anything that needs a wallet signature stay in https://console.hippius.com. After the user copies the API token, call https://api.hippius.com with `Authorization: Token <token>`.

```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Token $HIPPIUS_TOKEN" https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/credits/balance/
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Token $HIPPIUS_TOKEN" https://api.hippius.com/api/registry/me/
curl -sS https://api.hippius.com/api/drive/plans/
curl -sS https://api.hippius.com/api/s3/plans/
curl -sS https://api.hippius.com/api/registry/plans/
curl -sS https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/latest-tao-price/
```

The plan lists and the TAO price answer without a token. Balance and `registry/me` need one. S3 key create, rotate, and revoke are in Management API. The OpenAPI spec is https://api.hippius.com/?format=openapi

### Desktop

There is no desktop CLI. The agent cannot click the app, sign in, or read files. The user installs it and signs in themselves.

- https://hippius.com/desktop-app
- Latest release: https://github.com/thenervelab/hippius-desktop/releases/latest
  - macOS: `Hippius_universal.dmg`
  - Windows: `Hippius_<version>_x64-setup.exe` or the `.msi`
  - Linux (Debian and Ubuntu, x86_64): `Hippius_<version>_amd64.deb`
- Point at the release marked Latest. Pre-releases titled `[BETA]` and `[STAGING]` are not the stable build.

Sign-in is Google, GitHub, Apple, or an existing 12-word access key. Guide: https://docs.hippius.com/use/desktop/getting-started
Agent file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thenervelab/hippius-desktop/staging/llms.txt

### Bridge

There is no bridge CLI. The user opens Wallet in the console and uses Bridge Tokens. Guide: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/bridge

The bridge moves Alpha on Bittensor and hAlpha on Hippius. They are pegged 1:1. The minimum is 15 Alpha or 15 hAlpha. It takes about 120 seconds. The only cost is network gas: TAO on the Bittensor side, hAlpha on Hippius.

Alpha to hAlpha needs 3 signatures, or 4 when the Alpha must first be moved onto the Hippius validator. hAlpha to Alpha needs 1 signature. The user approves each signature in a browser wallet extension. An agent cannot approve those signatures.

### Compute

There is no compute CLI and no public VM API. Hippius VMs are not offered yet: https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/virtual-machines

Prices and launch steps are not published. Hub stores images. It does not run them.

---

## S3 Storage — Quickstart

Endpoint: https://s3.hippius.com
Region: decentralized
Signature: AWS Signature V4
Addressing style: path-style

Always use https://s3.hippius.com. Do not point clients at other hostnames.

Step 1: Create an account at https://console.hippius.com (Google, GitHub, Apple, or a 12-word access key)
Step 2: Top up on Billing by card, Bitcoin, USDC, or TAO, then subscribe if the product needs a plan. https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/billing
Step 3: Create credentials — Console > S3 Storage > Create Master Token
Step 4: Save Access Key ID (hip_...) and Secret Key — the secret cannot be retrieved after creation

IMPORTANT: ETH wallets, TAO wallets, and Polkadot browser extensions are NOT used for S3 access. Card, Bitcoin, USDC, and TAO add to the balance. They do not authenticate S3 requests.

### First upload (Python)

    pip install minio
    from minio import Minio
    from io import BytesIO
    client = Minio("s3.hippius.com", access_key="hip_your_key", secret_key="your_secret", secure=True, region="decentralized")
    client.make_bucket("my-first-bucket")
    content = b"Hello from Hippius!"
    client.put_object("my-first-bucket", "hello.txt", BytesIO(content), len(content), content_type="text/plain")
    print("Uploaded!")

### First upload (AWS CLI)

    export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="hip_your_key"
    export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="your_secret"
    aws s3 mb s3://my-bucket --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
    aws s3 cp file.txt s3://my-bucket/ --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com

---

## S3 Storage — Advanced Usage

Docs: https://docs.hippius.com/storage/s3/advanced

Always use https://s3.hippius.com. Region is always `decentralized`.

### Presigned GET (share a download, max 7 days)

    url = s3.generate_presigned_url("get_object", Params={"Bucket": "my-bucket", "Key": "file.txt"}, ExpiresIn=86400)

Do not append extra query parameters to a presigned URL — they invalidate the signature.

### Presigned PUT (browser upload without exposing keys)

    const uploadUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, new PutObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "upload.jpg" }), { expiresIn: 300 });
    await fetch(uploadUrl, { method: "PUT", body: file, headers: { "Content-Type": file.type } });

### Public buckets

    aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket my-bucket --acl public-read --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com

Public URL: https://s3.hippius.com/{bucket}/{key}

### ACLs

Permission types: READ, WRITE, READ_ACP, WRITE_ACP, FULL_CONTROL.
Always include --grant-full-control for yourself when sharing.

    aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket my-bucket \
      --grant-read 'id="their_canonical_id"' \
      --grant-full-control 'id="your_canonical_id"' \
      --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com

Hippius extension: grant a single access key with accessKey="hip_...".
Master keys bypass ACLs. Sub-tokens need an explicit grant unless scoped to that bucket at creation.

### Sub-tokens

Scoped credentials: per-bucket, read-only or read/write, optional expiry.
Create in Console > S3 Buckets (https://docs.hippius.com/use/console/s3) or via Management API.
Rotate keeps the Access Key ID and issues a new secret. Revoke is immediate.

    curl -X POST https://api.hippius.com/api/objectstore/sub-tokens/ \
      -H "Authorization: Token YOUR_BEARER_TOKEN" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"name": "read-only-backup", "permissions": ["read"]}'

    curl -X POST https://api.hippius.com/api/objectstore/master-tokens/{id}/revoke/ \
      -H "Authorization: Token YOUR_BEARER_TOKEN"

    curl -X POST https://api.hippius.com/api/objectstore/master-tokens/{id}/rotate/ \
      -H "Authorization: Token YOUR_BEARER_TOKEN"

### Large files

Console upload cap is 100 MB. Use multipart via AWS CLI / SDKs for larger objects (up to ~5 TiB).

### Object Lock

WORM retention (GOVERNANCE / COMPLIANCE) and legal holds. COMPLIANCE cannot be bypassed.
Docs: https://docs.hippius.com/storage/s3/object-lock

HCFS S3-compatible gateway (https://docs.hippius.com/hcfs/api/s3-gateway) is NOT s3.hippius.com.

---

## S3 Storage — Python

### boto3

    pip install boto3

    import boto3
    from botocore.config import Config
    s3 = boto3.client(
        "s3",
        endpoint_url="https://s3.hippius.com",
        aws_access_key_id="hip_your_key",
        aws_secret_access_key="your_secret",
        region_name="decentralized",
        config=Config(signature_version="s3v4", s3={"addressing_style": "path"}),
    )

    # Create bucket
    s3.create_bucket(Bucket="my-bucket")

    # Upload from disk
    s3.upload_file("local.txt", "my-bucket", "remote.txt")

    # Upload from memory
    s3.put_object(Bucket="my-bucket", Key="hello.txt", Body=b"Hello!")

    # Download to disk
    s3.download_file("my-bucket", "remote.txt", "local.txt")

    # Download to memory
    obj = s3.get_object(Bucket="my-bucket", Key="hello.txt")
    print(obj["Body"].read().decode())

    # List objects
    for obj in s3.list_objects_v2(Bucket="my-bucket").get("Contents", []):
        print(obj["Key"], obj["Size"])

    # Presigned URL (1 hour)
    url = s3.generate_presigned_url("get_object", Params={"Bucket": "my-bucket", "Key": "file.txt"}, ExpiresIn=3600)

### minio SDK

    pip install minio

    from minio import Minio
    from io import BytesIO
    from datetime import timedelta

    client = Minio("s3.hippius.com", access_key="hip_your_key", secret_key="your_secret", secure=True, region="decentralized")

    client.make_bucket("my-bucket")
    client.fput_object("my-bucket", "remote.txt", "local.txt")
    client.fget_object("my-bucket", "remote.txt", "downloaded.txt")

    for obj in client.list_objects("my-bucket", recursive=True):
        print(obj.object_name, obj.size)

    url = client.presigned_get_object("my-bucket", "file.txt", expires=timedelta(hours=1))

---

## S3 Storage — JavaScript

### AWS SDK v3

    npm install @aws-sdk/client-s3 @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner

    import { S3Client, CreateBucketCommand, PutObjectCommand, GetObjectCommand, ListObjectsV2Command } from "@aws-sdk/client-s3";
    import { getSignedUrl } from "@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner";

    const s3 = new S3Client({
        endpoint: "https://s3.hippius.com",
        region: "decentralized",
        credentials: { accessKeyId: "hip_your_key", secretAccessKey: "your_secret" },
        forcePathStyle: true,
    });

    await s3.send(new CreateBucketCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket" }));
    await s3.send(new PutObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "hello.txt", Body: "Hello!", ContentType: "text/plain" }));

    const res = await s3.send(new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "hello.txt" }));
    const text = await res.Body.transformToString();

    const list = await s3.send(new ListObjectsV2Command({ Bucket: "my-bucket" }));
    for (const obj of list.Contents ?? []) console.log(obj.Key, obj.Size);

    const url = await getSignedUrl(s3, new GetObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "file.txt" }), { expiresIn: 3600 });

### Browser uploads with presigned URLs

Server generates presigned PUT URL, browser uses it — no credentials in the browser:

    // Server
    const uploadUrl = await getSignedUrl(s3, new PutObjectCommand({ Bucket: "my-bucket", Key: "upload.jpg" }), { expiresIn: 300 });

    // Browser
    await fetch(uploadUrl, { method: "PUT", body: file, headers: { "Content-Type": file.type } });

---

## S3 Storage — AWS CLI

    # Install: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/install-cliv2.html
    aws configure --profile hippius
    # AWS Access Key ID: hip_your_key
    # AWS Secret Access Key: your_secret
    # Default region: decentralized

    aws s3 ls --profile hippius --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
    aws s3 mb s3://my-bucket --profile hippius --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
    aws s3 cp ./file.txt s3://my-bucket/ --profile hippius --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
    aws s3 cp s3://my-bucket/file.txt . --profile hippius --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
    aws s3 sync ./folder s3://my-bucket/folder --profile hippius --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
    aws s3 rm s3://my-bucket/file.txt --profile hippius --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com
    aws s3 presign s3://my-bucket/file.txt --expires-in 3600 --profile hippius --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com

---

## S3 Storage — rclone

    # Install: https://rclone.org/install/
    # ~/.config/rclone/rclone.conf
    [hippius]
    type = s3
    provider = Other
    access_key_id = hip_your_key
    secret_access_key = your_secret
    endpoint = https://s3.hippius.com
    region = decentralized
    acl = private

    rclone lsd hippius:                                  # list buckets
    rclone ls hippius:my-bucket                          # list files
    rclone copy ./file.txt hippius:my-bucket/            # upload file
    rclone sync ./folder hippius:my-bucket/folder        # sync folder
    rclone copy hippius:my-bucket/file.txt ./downloads/  # download

    # Mount as local drive (requires FUSE)
    mkdir -p ~/hippius-mount
    rclone mount hippius:my-bucket ~/hippius-mount --daemon

---

## S3 Storage — Compatibility

Docs: https://docs.hippius.com/storage/s3/compatibility

Supported operations:
- Bucket: CreateBucket, DeleteBucket, ListBuckets, HeadBucket, GetBucketLocation
- Object: PutObject, GetObject, HeadObject, DeleteObject, CopyObject
- List: ListObjects, ListObjectsV2
- Multipart: InitiateMultipartUpload, UploadPart, CompleteMultipartUpload, AbortMultipartUpload (up to ~5 TiB)
- Tags: PutObjectTagging, GetObjectTagging, DeleteObjectTagging, PutBucketTagging, GetBucketTagging
- ACL: PutBucketAcl, GetBucketAcl, PutObjectAcl, GetObjectAcl
- Policy: PutBucketPolicy, GetBucketPolicy, DeleteBucketPolicy
- Versioning: PutBucketVersioning (Enabled only; Suspended returns 501), GetBucketVersioning, ListObjectVersions
- Object Lock: Put/Get ObjectLockConfiguration, Retention, LegalHold (GOVERNANCE and COMPLIANCE)
- Presigned URLs GET/PUT/DELETE (max 7 days), range requests, video streaming
- Lifecycle: basic expiration rules only

Not supported: S3 Select, POST Object, virtual-hosted style, event notifications, S3 Batch Operations, cross-region replication (network replicates automatically)

### Public buckets

    # Make bucket public (AWS CLI)
    aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket my-bucket --acl public-read --endpoint-url https://s3.hippius.com

    # Or use bucket policy (Python)
    import json
    policy = {"Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow", "Principal": "*", "Action": ["s3:GetObject"], "Resource": [f"arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"]}]}
    client.set_bucket_policy("my-bucket", json.dumps(policy))

Public URL format: https://s3.hippius.com/{bucket-name}/{object-key}

### Rate limits

100 requests per minute per account

---

## Storage Architecture

Arion is Hippius's purpose-built distributed storage engine.

### How it works

Upload flow:
    Client → Gateway (HTTP, :3000) → Validator (:3002)
                                          ↓
                               Reed-Solomon encode
                               k=10 data + m=20 parity shards
                               2 MiB stripes
                                          ↓
                               CRUSH placement (topology-aware)
                                          ↓
                               P2P push to Miners (:3001+) via QUIC/Iroh

Download flow:
    Gateway fetches any k=10 shards from miners → reconstructs → returns to client

Recovery:
    Warden audits miners for proof-of-storage
    Validator detects offline miners → fetches k=10 shards → rebuilds → places on new miners

### Key properties

- Any 10 of 30 shards reconstruct the original file
- CRUSH algorithm: deterministic placement, no central directory lookup
- QUIC-based P2P: low latency, encrypted, multiplexed
- Proof-of-storage: Plonky3 ZK circuits (pos-circuits)
- Chain submitter publishes cluster maps to Hippius blockchain

---

## Run a Miner

Miners provide storage capacity and earn rewards. Requires running two components:
1. Hippius Blockchain Node (for on-chain registration)
2. Arion Miner (actual storage mining)

### Hardware requirements

- CPU: 4+ dedicated cores (8+ vCPUs recommended)
- RAM: 16 GB minimum (32 GB recommended)
- Storage: 2 TB minimum (NVMe SSD preferred)
- Network: 1 Gbps, static public IP

### Step 1: Run blockchain node

    git clone https://github.com/thenervelab/thebrain.git && cd thebrain
    cargo build --release
    ./target/release/hippius \
      --base-path /var/lib/hippius/chain \
      --chain mainnet \
      --bootnodes /ip4/198.244.165.236/tcp/30333/ws/p2p/12D3KooWAXNTAcp2d8rFG6iW43nYhkciWepUFJxr8yzZbELyYByb \
      --offchain-worker Always

### Step 2: Run Arion miner

    git clone https://github.com/thenervelab/arion.git && cd arion
    cargo build --release --bin miner
    export VALIDATOR_NODE_ID="185651f2fb19c919d40c3c58660cf463ebe7ded1c1a326eef4dad28292171cdb"
    export WARDEN_NODE_ID="70d27c756b0f9a71fc89a6e571c9bdf9e63f8531e125714d0f164be0e11e6846"
    export FAMILY_ID="<your-coldkey-ss58>"
    export STORAGE_PATH="/var/lib/hippius/miner/data"
    export MAX_STORAGE=2000000000000  # 2TB in bytes
    ./target/release/miner

### Step 3: Register on-chain

See full guide at: https://docs.hippius.com/earn/arion/running-miner

---

## Miner CLI

`miner-cli` manages on-chain miner lifecycle.

    git clone https://github.com/thenervelab/arion.git && cd arion
    cargo build --release --bin miner-cli

    # Show miner node ID
    miner-cli --chain-ws-url wss://rpc.hippius.network --family-mnemonic-file /secure/mnemonic.txt show-node-id

    # Register miner
    miner-cli --chain-ws-url wss://rpc.hippius.network --family-mnemonic-file /secure/mnemonic.txt \
      register-child --child-ss58 5FHneW46...

    # Deregister (begins unbonding)
    miner-cli --chain-ws-url wss://rpc.hippius.network --family-mnemonic-file /secure/mnemonic.txt \
      deregister-child --child-ss58 5FHneW46...

    # Claim deposit after unbonding
    miner-cli --chain-ws-url wss://rpc.hippius.network --family-mnemonic-file /secure/mnemonic.txt \
      claim-unbonded --child-ss58 5FHneW46...

Registration model:
    Family account (coldkey) → Child account (hotkey, receives rewards) → NodeId (P2P identity)

---

## Staking

Hippius uses Nominated Proof of Stake (NPoS). Stake hAlpha tokens to nominate validators and earn rewards.

- Stake via Console > Wallet > Staking, or via Desktop App
- Unstaking triggers an unbonding period before funds are available
- No minimum stake required
- Rewards distributed per era (~24 hours)

Token types:
- Alpha: native Hippius chain, used for staking and governance
- hAlpha: EVM-compatible, used for DeFi and exchanges

---

## Management API

Docs: https://docs.hippius.com/use/api
Full OpenAPI spec: https://api.hippius.com/?format=openapi

Auth: account API token from https://console.hippius.com/dashboard/settings
Header: Authorization: Token <token>
Browser OAuth handoff, not the agent path: POST https://api.hippius.com/api/auth/exchange/ with JSON {"code": "..."}

### Endpoints

Token management:
    GET/POST https://api.hippius.com/api/objectstore/master-tokens/
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/objectstore/master-tokens/{id}/revoke/
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/objectstore/master-tokens/{id}/rotate/
    GET/POST https://api.hippius.com/api/objectstore/sub-tokens/

Balance (path still says credits):
    GET  https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/credits/balance/

Subscribe from the existing balance (201). Do not use Stripe Checkout when the balance already covers the plan:
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/drive/subscription/     {"plan":"solo","period":"monthly","payment":"credits"}
                                                             Drive codes: solo, duo, max, scale
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/s3/subscription/        {"plan":"pro","rail":"credits"}
                                                             S3 codes: pro, business, enterprise
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/registry/subscribe/     {"plan":"Builder"}
                                                             Hub names: Free, Builder, Pro, Team
    GET  https://api.hippius.com/api/drive/plans/
    GET  https://api.hippius.com/api/s3/plans/
    GET  https://api.hippius.com/api/registry/plans/

Top up (browser or wallet, not subscribe):
    GET  https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/latest-tao-price/
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/stripe/create-checkout-session/
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/stripe/create-subscription/
    GET  https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/stripe/subscription-plans/
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/btcpay/create-invoice/
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/x402/topup/
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/transactions/
    GET  https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/transactions/
    GET  https://api.hippius.com/api/billing/transactions/{id}/

Support:
    POST https://api.hippius.com/api/support/tickets/
